svg.title: State replication bandwidth. PurrNet’s downstream bandwidth was 34% lower than FishNet across the state replication workloads. NetworkTransform + SyncVars, 100 connections, 20 Hz.

cc:Work.dc:title: State replication bandwidth. PurrNet’s downstream bandwidth was 34% lower than FishNet across the state replication workloads. NetworkTransform + SyncVars, 100 connections, 20 Hz.
cc:Work.dc:description: Arithmetic mean of server txBytesPerSec. Tests: MoveY, MoveWander, SyncVars. Sessions: 100 connections, 20 Hz. 10 s windows. No idle subtraction. Binary byte units (1 KiB = 1,024 bytes). One published run. Overloaded rows describe saturated servers and are not used for comparative claims.
